blocks.text: Five years ago, Towne Kids started with a simple belief: that Filipino nurses deserved a real opportunity to build their careers abroad, and that children with complex medical needs deserved care that was personal as well as clinical. Today, that belief has grown into a track record, 303 Filipino nurses, 231 women and 72 men, deployed to pediatric home-care assignments across New Jersey and Massachusetts. Now, as the company marks its fifth year, Towne Kids is taking its own Step Up. Through Step Up, Towne Kids is expanding its U.S. deployment pipeline by opening another pathway to qualified Filipino nurses currently […]...
